meta_description:
460 likes, 11 comments - amitbhawani on July 20, 2026: "Thank you to Shree Sanatan Bhawani Parivar for the honour of inviting and felicitating me at the Shree Surdan Dada Thirtdham Opening in Mathal, Kutch. It was truly a privilege to return to my roots and share a few thoughts with our community on AI, technology, business and personal growth.

We upgrade our phones.
We upgrade our cars.
We upgrade our homes.

But when was the last time we upgraded ourselves?

AI isn’t here to replace us. It’s here to help those who are willing to learn.

A small message from my address at the Shree Surdan Dada Thirtdham Opening organised by Shree Sanatan Bhawani Parivar in Mathal, Kutch.

Let’s keep learning. Let’s keep growing.

Jai Lakshmi Narayan 🙏
Jai Surdan Dada 🙏

#AI #Business #Technology #Entrepreneurship #DigitalMarketing Gujarati Kutch AmitBhawani".
